title: Full Stack Engineer
description: We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience building scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong proficiency in React and Node.js with hands-on experience in MongoDB and Express. You will be responsible for designing and implementing RESTful APIs, building responsive frontend interfaces, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
responsibilities: Build and maintain full stack web applications using React and Node.js
Design and implement RESTful APIs using Express and MongoDB
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement responsive interfaces
Participate in code reviews and agile sprints
requirements: 3+ years of experience in full stack development
Strong knowledge of JavaScript, React, and Node.js
Familiarity with Git and agile workflows
